title: panels are not restored correctly when restoring saved global theme
line: Applying a saved global theme puts each panel back on the screen it was saved on, instead of all on one screen.
explanation: A saved global theme stores each panel's screen as lastScreen in its config, but loadSerializedLayout() created every panel through ShellCorona::addPanel(), which puts it on the active screen, and only wrote the saved lastScreen into the config without moving the panel. So all panels came back on one screen (and only jumped to their saved screen after a plasmashell restart). The change reads the saved lastScreen and, if that screen is connected, moves the panel there with the existing setScreen() before the rest of the panel setup.

commits.message:
scripting: restore a serialized panel on its saved screen

loadSerializedLayout() created every panel through addPanel(), which
puts it on the active screen, so a saved global theme brought all of its
panels back on one screen. Move each panel to its saved lastScreen first.

BUG: 514584

media.caption: Master, two screens: after applying the saved theme the top panel that was on the right screen comes back on the left one; the right screen has no panel
With the fix: the top panel is back on the right screen, the bottom panel on the left one

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in the right layer (loadSerializedLayout in plasma-workspace) that moves each deserialized panel to its saved lastScreen when that screen is currently connected, before applying the rest of the panel geometry and config. Missing or disconnected screens safely fall back to the active screen so panels remain visible, and both integer and string lastScreen values are handled via toVariant().toInt(). The before/after multi-screen screenshots and verification notes convincingly prove the fix and check single-screen and restart behavior. Using qobject_cast<ShellCorona *> instead of static_cast would be slightly more defensive (matching other methods in the file), but this is ready for MR.

The before/after multi-screen screenshots and verification notes convincingly prove the fix and check single-screen and restart behavior. Using qobject_cast<ShellCorona *> instead of static_cast would be slightly more defensive (matching other methods in the file), but this is ready for MR.

The remaining part of this report on master is the multi-screen one (comment 5: all panels come back on the primary screen, stacked); the size/Fit/floating parts from the description and comments 8-10 are already restored correctly on master, as the sweep rig confirmed. The fix is in the right place: loadSerializedLayout() created panels via addPanel() on the active screen and never moved them, so reading the saved lastScreen and calling the existing Containment::setScreen() (ShellCorona::setScreenForContainment, which also moves an existing PanelView) before location/size setup is a minimal, sound change, guarded by screenForId() so a theme saved on two screens and applied on one keeps its panels visible, and old themes without lastScreen are unaffected. Before/after shots on two outputs show the top panel returning to screen 1.
